frozen_note: Written before vlm.py existed or ran. Thresholds are never changed after a result; a FAIL is kept.
method: steady horseshoe vortex-lattice method (Katz & Plotkin, Low-Speed Aerodynamics, 2nd ed., ch. 12; recalled, not re-read here): bound vortex on each panel's 1/4-chord, collocation at 3/4-chord, trailing legs to infinity along the free stream, camber through the boundary-condition normal, Kutta-Joukowski force per bound segment
validity: inviscid, attached flow, small angle of attack, thin lifting surface; no thickness, no viscosity, no separation, no free surface; Reynolds-number independent

V1_elliptic_AR6.what: flat elliptic wing AR 6 at 4 deg, 12 chordwise x 40 spanwise (cosine)

V2_elliptic_AR20.what: flat elliptic wing AR 20 at 4 deg

V3_refinement.what: V1 with panels doubled each way

V4_camber.what: rectangular AR 20 wing at 0 deg with parabolic camber 4% (via BC normals)
V4_camber.reference: thin-airfoil zero-lift angle -2 m rad, so CL(0) = CL_alpha * 2 m with CL_alpha from the same wing at 4 deg

V5_mutant_collocation_quarter_chord.what: V1 with collocation moved to 1/4 chord (wrong rule)

fish_rules.geometry: fish3d-v3 panels.json (membrane mid-surface) from 8dc5cc4; candidate_sha256 checked against components.json
fish_rules.lifting_surfaces: pectoral_L/R and pelvic_L/R only; median fins (dorsal, anal, caudal) carry no lift at zero sideslip and are left out, stated
fish_rules.body: not modelled: isolated fins, no wing-body carry-over; stated beside every number
fish_rules.aoa_limit: results above 8 deg are not produced: a thin plate at Re ~1e5 separates; VLM would over-predict
fish_rules.membrane_thickness_rule: membrane 0.10 mm and rays 0.60 mm are below any 3-D grid here; VLM treats the fin as a zero-thickness surface, which is the approximation, not a resolution of the membrane
fish_rules.output: per claude-07 quad: dCp = Cp_lower - Cp_upper along the upper normal, area, normal, candidate_sha256
